steps.title: Analyze Build Log Failure
steps.description: Read and identify the precise location of the attribute linking error in the layout resources.

steps.title: Inspect Activity Layout Structure
steps.description: Open and inspect the XML structure of activity_main.xml to find references to layout_centerY.

steps.title: Correct Header Bar Layout Alignment
steps.description: Replace the incorrect 'android:layout_centerY' attribute with the standard 'android:layout_centerVertical' attribute on the header title.

steps.title: Inspect Input Field Attributes
steps.description: Verify port input text element and make sure its gravity, alignment, and spacing are standardized.

steps.title: Validate Console ScrollView
steps.description: Ensure nested scrollable elements inside the main activity layout have proper heights and layout weights.

steps.title: Verify Manifest Definitions
steps.description: Ensure xmlns:android namespace is exactly configured to 'http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android' inside AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Check Foreground Service Type
steps.description: Verify the TunnelService declaration conforms to Android 14's specialUse background execution specifications.

steps.title: Verify Java API Compatibility
steps.description: Verify MainActivity.java compilation parameters and run-time permission logic are safe for SDK levels 21 to 34.

steps.title: Validate Gradle Dependencies
steps.description: Confirm that the top-level build.gradle and app-level build.gradle are correctly synchronized and do not introduce external conflicts.

steps.title: Building Local Server Tunnel
steps.description: Compile the entire Android project, generating a deployable APK via Gradle build operations.
